equality_criterion.basis_invariance: Replacing R by R C congruently transforms the equality core by C^T(-)C; changing X by a kernel-valued solution changes U^T X by a term annihilated between R^T and R.
equality_criterion.core_laplacian_identity: For the cubic 36-vertex neighbor core A_core, rank_F7(K_39)=1+rank_F7(3I-A_core).
equality_criterion.statement: For B=H^T U of minimum rank e and R spanning ker(B), solve S X=U R. Then rank([[S,U],[U^T,W]])=25 iff R^T(W R-U^T X)=0.
